2: For the music director; on the Sheminith. A psalm of David. Save, O Yahweh, for the pious have ceased to be; for the faithful have vanished from among the children of humankind.
3: They speak falseness ⌞to each other⌟. With flattering lips, with ⌞a double heart⌟ they speak.
4: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, the tongue speaking great boasts—
5: those who say, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are on our side. Who is master over us?”
6: “Because of the oppression of the afflicted, because of the groaning of the poor, now I will rise up,” Yahweh says. “I shall put them in the safety for which they long.”
7: The words of Yahweh are pure words like silver refined in the crucible on the ground, refined seven times.
8: You, O Yahweh, will protect them. You will preserve him from this generation always.
9: The wicked prowl about when vileness is exalted among the children of humankind.
